title: Monkeys and Others
description: Makes the jungle biome more alive and filled.
body:
🐒 **Monkeys and Others**!

![monkey](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/05f62891d2c747717121f79741de92443bfb556a.png)

Bringing life to jungle biomes!
This mod adds monkeys and other creatures to make the world feel more alive and dynamic.

### 🌟 Features
### 🐒 Monkey Entity
Spawns in jungle biomes during the day

Eats fruits and food (bananas, apples, berries, and more!)

Can sit and relax when not disturbed

Protects their young – babies call for help when attacked

Has unique animations powered by GeckoLib

### 🍌 **Banana Bush**
Generates naturally in jungle biomes

Has multiple growth stages

Harvest bananas when fully grown

### 🎭 **Monkey Mask**
Wearable armor (helmet slot)

Crafted with bananas

### 🍌 **Banana**
Food item used for breeding and taming

Restores hunger

### **How to Play**
Finding Monkeys
Explore jungle biomes

Feeding & Breeding
Feed monkeys any of these items to attract or breed them:

- 🍌 Banana
- 
- 🍎 Apple / Golden Apple
- 
- 🫐 Sweet Berries / Glow Berries
- 
- 🍉 Melon Slice
- 
- 🥕 Carrot / Golden Carrot
- 
- 🥔 Potato / Baked Potato
- 
- 🍞 Bread
- 
- 🍪 Cookie
- 
- 🎃 Pumpkin Pie
- 
- 🥬 Beetroot

Breeding
Feed two monkeys with fruits

They will breed and produce a baby monkey

Babies grow into adults over time

Monkey Mask Crafting
Use bananas to craft the mask

Wear it on your head for a monkey disguise!

### 📦 **Dependencies**
Required:

GeckoLib 4.8.2 and higher – required for animations
